definitions.explanation: The Japanese government ministry responsible for national defense and for running the Self-Defense Forces ({自衛隊|じえいたい}). It was the Defense Agency ({防衛庁|ぼうえいちょう}) until it became a full ministry in 2007.

examples.japanese: {防衛省|ぼうえいしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勤|つと}める→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: She works at the Ministry of Defense.

examples.japanese: {防衛省|ぼうえいしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会見|かいけん}→会見：11447_kaiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The Ministry of Defense held a press conference.

examples.japanese: {防衛省|ぼうえいしょう}⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{今朝|けさ}→今朝：02877_kesa⟧⟦ミサイル→ミサイル：26959_misairu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発射|はっしゃ}→発射：03695_hassha⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: According to the Ministry of Defense, a missile was launched this morning.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{防衛|ぼうえい}→防衛：09783_bouei⟧⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧: the Minister of Defense
- {防衛省|ぼうえいしょう}⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧: according to the Ministry of Defense
- {防衛省|ぼうえいしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧: an announcement by the Ministry of Defense
- ⟦{防衛|ぼうえい}→防衛：09783_bouei⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧: the defense budget

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{自衛隊|じえいたい}→自衛隊：05790_jieitai⟧: the Self-Defense Forces, which the ministry runs
